items.description: The Nylon Pool is a famous shallow, crystal-clear sandbar off the coast of Tobago, a popular spot for leisure and swimming.
The bird sanctuary on Little Tobago is a critical habitat for exotic seabirds, highly valued for birdwatching tours.
The Botanical Gardens in Scarborough feature a diverse collection of tropical plants, offering a peaceful recreational space in Tobago.
The dairy farms in Siparia represent the importance of local agriculture and rural livelihoods in southern Trinidad.
Point Fortin Beach Park provides a recreational seaside area for the local community, promoting outdoor leisure and heritage.
Chacachacare Island is a remote, historic site off the coast of Trinidad, known for its unique natural environment and ruins.
Saut d'Eau Island is a small, rugged offshore island known for its natural beauty and diverse coastal wildlife.
